nodes.name: forecast-plot-payload.md
nodes.summary: Research note for ticket 06 on what Forecast already returns for a Dashboard chart: horizon-end SARIMA and Holt–Winters scalars with intervals, not history or day-by-day paths. Maps ForecastResult, forecast_for_tool JSON, citation tags, Urals/history-fail payloads, and what a chart must add to draw time series.

nodes.name: session-start-search-web.md
nodes.summary: Fact sheet for ticket 08 on calling search_for_tool / oil_gas_web without an Ouroboros task: signatures, return dict, citation labels, empty-query and DuckDuckGo soft-fail behavior, timeouts, and Docker failure modes. Explicitly does not authorize bypassing the agent loop (ticket 05 / ADR 0019).

nodes.name: streamlit-ouroboros-adapter.md
nodes.summary: Research for ticket 07 on using Streamlit as a thin Chat UI adapter over the same Analyst turn as Chainlit: build_loop warm/attest/toggle, run_turn, session/timeout/rate-limit hooks, compose port 8000, and risks of two UIs in one image. Recommends in-process Python seams rather than a second HTTP agent loop.
